tools.name: cdcx_market_risk-params
tools.description: Provides information on risk parameter settings for [Smart Cross Margin](https://crypto.com/exchange/document/margin-rules).

tools.name: cdcx_market_instruments
tools.description: Provides information on all supported instruments (e.g. BTCUSD-PERP).

event_symbols.description: Filter by up to 10 event symbols. Comma-separated.

tools.name: cdcx_market_book
tools.description: Fetches the public order book for a particular instrument and depth.

depth.description: Number of bids and asks to return (up to 50)

tools.name: cdcx_market_candlestick
tools.description: Retrieves candlesticks (k-line data history) over a given period for an instrument (e.g. BTCUSD-PERP).

count.description: Number of candles to return. Default 25.

end_ts.description: End time (Unix timestamp). Default current time.

start_ts.description: Start time (Unix timestamp). Default 1 day ago.

tools.name: cdcx_market_trades
tools.description: Fetches the public trades for a particular instrument. Time window can only be up to 7 days for maximum.

count.description: The maximum number of trades to be retrieved. Default: 25. Max: 150

end_ts.description: End time in Unix time format (exclusive). Default: current system timestamp. Nanosecond recommended for accurate pagination

start_ts.description: Start time in Unix time format (inclusive). Default: end_time - 1 day. Nanosecond recommended for accurate pagination

tools.name: cdcx_market_ticker
tools.description: Fetches the public tickers for all or a particular instrument.

tools.name: cdcx_market_valuations
tools.description: Fetches valuation type data for an instrument.

end_ts.description: Default timestamp is current time (Unix timestamp).

start_ts.description: Default timestamp is 30 days ago for funding_hist, and 1 day ago for other valuation_type (Unix timestamp).

valuation_type.description:
**List of available types:**
- a. **index_price**: returns per minute data of underlying reference price of the instrument.
- b. **mark_price**: returns per minute data of mark price of the instrument.
- c. **funding_hist**: returns hourly data of the funding rate settled in past hourly settlement.
- d. **funding_rate**: returns per minute data of current hourly funding rate that will settle at the end of each hour of current 4-hour interval.
- e. **estimated_funding_rate**: returns per minute data of estimated funding rate for the next interval.

tools.name: cdcx_market_settlement-prices
tools.description: Fetches settlement prices of expired instruments.

tools.name: cdcx_market_insurance
tools.description: Fetches the balance of the Insurance Fund for a particular currency.

end_ts.description: Default timestamp is current time (Unix timestamp).

start_ts.description: Default timestamp is 1 day ago (Unix timestamp).
